assets.notes: Wasp naked sport bike. fork: origin on the steering axis at the steering head, local Z = steering axis (rake 25 deg). Seat markers are hip points 0.25 above the cushion.

BMX. fork: local Z = steering axis (rake 16 deg). crank: origin at the bottom bracket, spins about X, rest pose = cranks level (right pedal forward). Chain ring is part of body as specified. seat_driver = hip point 0.25 above the saddle.

Marlin speedboat. z=0 waterline, keel -0.45, gunwale +0.75, windscreen top 1.6. motor: twin outboards, origin at the transom pivot (turn about local Z). prop: both propellers, origin on the hub line between them (spin about Y). steering: local Y = column axis.

Dragonfly light helicopter. Origin under the rotor mast (centre of the skid footprint), z=0 at the skid bottoms. rotor_main: origin at the mast top, spins about Z (3 blades, dia 9.4). rotor_tail: origin at the tail hub on the left of the fin, spins about X. Doors hinged at the front edge (open about local Z: left door negative, right positive). col_body includes the skid footprint.

Kestrel high-wing 4-seat prop plane. Origin on the ground under the wing quarter chord, z=0 at the wheel bottoms, level attitude. prop: origin at the hub, spins about Y. aileron_l/_r, elevator: origin on the hinge line, local X along it (both ailerons point local X to the right). rudder: hinge = local Z. door_fl hinged at its front edge (only the left door opens). Tip lights: @LightIndL left, @LightIndR right; landing light (@LightHead, marker light_head_l) in the left wing leading edge.

Skywatch twin-engine police helicopter. Origin under the rotor mast, z=0 at the skid bottoms. rotor_main: origin at the mast top, spins about Z (4 blades, dia 10.6). rotor_tail: fenestron fan inside the shrouded tail, origin at the fan hub, spins about X. searchlight: pod under the nose, origin at its gimbal, lens (@LightHead) looks along +Y at rest. Open rear side doors; gunner_l / gunner_r = hip points on jump seats facing outward (rotated -/+90 deg about Z). Strobes @LightSirenA (left) / B (right). No doors.
